name: Symmetric Encryption
description: Encrypt and decrypt with SM4 or AES in ECB / CBC / CTR / OFB / CFB / GCM mode.

hints.mode: AES supports only ECB / CBC / CTR / GCM; zero and no padding apply to SM4 ECB / CBC only.
hints.padding: "No padding" requires the input length to be a multiple of 16 bytes.

faq.q: Why does GCM decryption report TAG_INVALID?
faq.a: The tag is missing or truncated, or the key / nonce / AAD differ from encryption.

faq.q: Why is ECB flagged as risky?
faq.a: ECB provides no diffusion, so identical plaintext blocks yield identical ciphertext blocks.

faq.q: What happens when no nonce is given for GCM?
faq.a: A random nonce is generated and returned with the result; reuse it for decryption.
